SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: Independently hashed all six exact official sources. The newer held JDF615 remains SHA106cbd5edad2272f3f6f1378450b007507da879e6a917437d2cc3bb062d87647. JDF205,206,613,614 resolve through governed source adoption. COMPONENT_SET.finding: Read held official JDF611 instructions directly: initial filing requires JDF612,613,614,615, with JDF205 and206 conditional on inability to pay. Criminal history and record-comparison prerequisites are preserved; unheld supporting documents are not asserted present.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Motion eligibility, recipient, court-type and financial elections remain for the participant as instructed. Required CBI selection belongs on JDF612, while every numbered JDF613/614/615/206 body belongs to the court. REPEATING_ROWS.finding: Inspected every agency, offense and fee-waiver household/income/asset row in both fixtures. Unheld rows remain wholly blank, and each applicable row's participant task is disclosed. No partially fabricated row or swapped identity appears; companion captions repeat the same held case identity.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Source-output pixel differences at144dpi show no added ink outside measured neutral-write rectangles and no removed source ink. All30 original central pages confirm judicial findings, hearing details, order dates/signatures, installment terms, attorney acts and future service/signature acts remain blank. JDF205 printed-name prefill is distinct from signature.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Both current PDFs are independently hash-bound and parsed at15pages each. All30 original central PNGs, archive digest, embedded verdict, byte lengths and calibrated paper bounds were independently verified; native artifact and job-log custody agree. No old raster is used for these changed bytes.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Both current packets follow source page order: five-page JDF612, one-page JDF613, one-page JDF614, three-page JDF615, three-page JDF205, two-page JDF206. All30 central page identities match current source manifests; nothing omitted, duplicated or exchanged.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Viewed every current central page, including boundary long caption/address and waiver identity fields. Official background and field geometry are preserved. Readable additions stay inside measured neutral surfaces; no clipping, overlap, erased legal content or internal route/component footer is present.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Instructions correctly direct filing to the clerk of the Colorado District or County Court that entered the conviction, matching the caption. Unheld courthouse mailing address is a required completion item; no unsupported destination is supplied.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: All five current registry stop conditions were independently matched to delivered instructions. exactDefects.defect: The packet tells the participant, in bold, that no form number exists for either missing document and that 'none should be inferred from this packet', on the stated ground that 'the guide renders those digits as vector glyphs'. That is false against the bytes the repository holds. `pdftotext` on the held JDF-611 (sha256 b628ee77cfdbb1e02208a74b04f6a03083e2843505f4bb4a7c3e0f2b3503843e) recovers, as plain text under the heading '③ File the Request — File these forms into your criminal case': 'JDF 612 Motion', 'JDF 613 Order (just do §§ A-C)', 'JDF 614 Notice (Just do §§ A-C)', 'JDF 615 Order (just do §§ A-C)'. The notice is JDF 614. The second order is JDF 613. Both identities are established by the very guide the manifest cites, and neither had to be inferred.

The identity claim above rests on the held JDF-611's own text, which was read from mounted bytes; the byte claim rests on the committed index, which is a record and not a re-hash.
exactDefects.noteForTheRepairLane: the recovery pool's filename calls JDF-613 the 'order denying request to seal conviction records'. That is consistent with Colorado practice of tendering both a grant order and a denial order, and it means the 'second order' is the DENIAL order rather than a second grant. Do not describe it to a participant as a second grant order without confirming it against the JDF-613 bytes.
exactDefects.repair: correct participant-instructions.md and source-receipt.json componentSetDelivery and the manifest's two sourceStatusBasis strings to name JDF 613 and JDF 614, quoting JDF-611 as the authority; and raise a source obligation to mount or promote the two recovery-pool binaries rather than a research task, because their identities are no longer unknown.
